Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ananda Sen.
 ------

For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Vikash Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Abhay Kr. Tiwari, App
05/14.06.2024 The petitioner, who is an accused for the offence punishable under Sections
323/341/376-D/504/506 of the Ipc, is praying for grant of regular bail, as he is in custody since
16.11.2019.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
Earlier the prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected.

Petitioner renewed his prayer on the ground that till date only two prosecution witnesses have been examined, though charge was framed way back on 17.11. 2021 and petitioner is in custody since 16.11.2019.
Petitioner is in custody for more than four and half years.
Prosecution has failed to produce all the witnesses.
Considering the attitude of the prosecution, I am inclined to allow this application as this Court cannot keep the petitioner in custody for an indefinite period.

Accordingly, the petitioner above named is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned District &
Additional Sessions Judge-II, Seraikella in connection with Kharsawan P.S. Case No. 74 of 2019,
corresponding to S.T. No. 67 of 2020, subject to the condition that one of the bailors must be close relative of the petitioner, having sufficient landed property in his own name or in the name of ancestor within the State of Jharkhand; the petitioner should appear once in every month before the Trial Court till disposal of this case.
